summary: standard_pack_check: evidence must exist, match its digest and prove S3-S5 with distinct CI/hosted/runtime proof

delivery.outcome: standard_pack_check rejects adoption evidence that does not prove its level: repository evidence must exist and match its digest, S3 must be a CI definition or external proof, S4/S5 external proof, and S3-S5 must each be distinct from lower-level proof
nonGoals: No migration of existing adoption records in consumer repositories
No change to the wellman bundled copy (separate repository)

architecture.decision: Validate each evidence item in adoption_record_findings; external proof is any RFC 3986 scheme URI, repository proof is a confined existing file with a matching SHA-256; a managed-script change ships as standard 0.20.104
architecture.rollback: Revert scripts/standard_pack_check.py and the new test.

validation.evidence: hollow, missing, mismatched and repository-S4 evidence rejected; honest evidence passes
existing pack and runtime safety tests and the gate pass
